chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Yaʿqūb, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from more than one narrator, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The shroud is torn open from near the head of the deceased when he is placed into his grave.”

key_terms.الْكَفَنُ: the burial shroud of the deceased
key_terms.رَأْسِ: the head; the side from which the shroud is opened

ai.seo_question: How should the kafan be opened when the deceased is placed into the grave according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a funerary ruling concerning the handling of the deceased at the time of burial. It states that the kafan is to be opened from the side of the head when the deceased is placed in the grave.
